items.title: Mongi courier - first-delivery hero with 'How it works' steps
items.description: Courier-app home greeting 'Glow Lab BD / Welcome, Priyanka'. A lime hero card reads 'Your first delivery / Book by 3 pm. Cash tonight. First 5 deliveries are ৳60 instead of ৳85.' with a black 'New delivery +' pill. A 'How it works' list numbers three steps - add the buyer and cash amount, a rider collects from your door (2-5 pm), cash in your bKash at 11 pm - each with a coloured numeral chip. Bottom nav: Home, Deliveries, +, Money, Account. The screen sells the whole loop: book, hand over, get paid.

items.title: HVAC field job - voice-note explain step with photos and work-type chips
items.description: Step 1 of 3 of an 'extra work' flow for a field-service job, under an explain/price/win rail. A 'what you found' card embeds a 0:22 voice-note waveform and its transcription - 'the electrical panel is full - no room for the new breaker; she needs a panel modification before i can set the condenser' - noted 'written up from your voice note'. A 'photos' row shows two attached site photos plus an add tile. A 'what kind of work?' chip row offers panel modification (selected), line set, disconnect box, drain pan, surge protector. A blue 'price it with ai' button closes the screen. The flow turns a spoken field observation into a priced change order.

items.title: HVAC field job - arrival status timeline synced with the office
items.description: An 'ac replacement' job screen. A lavender card announces 'sarah knows you're coming - we texted her an 8:55-9:10 am window' with an undo action. Rows list 'torres heating shop 10 min 4.2 mi' and '1420 elm street, austin' with a navigate button. A 'job status synced with the office' timeline steps through scheduled, on the way (active), arrived, in progress, completed. A blue 'I've arrived' button pins the foot. Customer, route and office stay in one synced view.

items.title: Mongi courier - new-delivery form filled from a pasted message
items.description: A 'New delivery' form for the courier app. 'Pickup from Tajmahal Rd studio' leads; a magenta banner says 'Filled from a pasted message - check the details below' with Undo. 'Deliver to' fields carry the buyer's phone 01819-442277 (with a '6 of 6 delivered' trust chip), name Tahmina Akter and a Mirpur address pinned on map. A 'Parcel' row offers Small/Medium/Large size cards; 'Cash to collect ৳1,850' and a Fragile toggle follow, closing on a black 'Choose speed' button. The pasted-message autofill is the notable idea.

items.title: Mongi courier - new-delivery form (near-identical capture)
items.description: A second capture of the same 'New delivery' form as IMG-0209: pickup from Tajmahal Rd studio, the magenta 'Filled from a pasted message' banner with Undo, Deliver-to fields (01819-442277, Tahmina Akter, House 12 Road 7 Block C Mirpur 10), Small/Medium/Large parcel cards, 'Cash to collect ৳1,850' and a black 'Choose speed' button. Useful as a variant render of the same screen; the two read as one design.

items.title: Mongi courier - Money screen with tonight's payout and weekly bars
items.description: The 'Money' tab of the courier app. A dark-green card states 'Tonight, 11 pm / ৳9,798 / From 6 delivered parcels today. Rumana's parcel retires tomorrow, free.' with a small chart. Lime 'Cash collected ৳10,360' and pink 'Fees: 6 x ৳85 + 12% = ৳562' tiles flank it. A 'This week' bar chart (Sat-Fri, today highlighted) sits above dated payout rows (Wed 3 Sep ৳14,238; Tue 6 Sep ৳11,480). Bottom nav marks Money active. A clear earnings ledger.

items.title: Mongi - 'Sell today. Delivered tonight.' landing screen
items.description: A marketing phone screen for 'mongi'. A dark-green hero collage shows the product's own live delivery cards (Today Mohammadpur, Sohel picked up, Out for delivery Tahmina Akter, Tonight 11 pm ৳9,798 to your bKash). Below, the headline 'Sell today. Delivered tonight.' with body 'Book by 3 pm. We pick up from your door, collect cash from your buyer and send it to your bKash the same night.', proof chips 'Cash on delivery' and 'Photo proof', a black 'Get started' button and 'Get the Mongi Rider app'. The hero uses real product cards as the visual.

items.title: Leasing portfolio - property list with occupancy and AI review chips
items.description: A property-management 'Properties' screen for Westminster, Austin TX. A stats strip reports Units 442, Occupied 94.1%, Available 37. Stacked property cards (The Alder 96%, Marlowe Court 93%) pair a photo with an availability chip, an occupancy figure and an 'AI knowledge: 1 to review' banner. A bottom nav ends on a black 'More' pill. Leading with occupancy lets a manager read portfolio health at a glance.

items.title: Leasing analytics - conversion headline over a yellow funnel
items.description: An 'Analytics / All properties / 90 days' screen. A saturated yellow card leads with 'Overall lease conversion 8.6% +1.2 pts / 128 leases from 1,482 leads' and a thin trend line. Below, a 'Leasing Funnel' renders horizontal hatched bars for Leads, Qualified, Tours, Applications, Approved and Leased with counts, then stat tiles and a nav ending in 'More'. The funnel is the story: every stage labelled and counted.

items.title: Leasing agent - tour follow-up task with AI message draft
items.description: A tour-task screen 'Tour - Confirmed by SMS / Sarah Mitchell' with call and WhatsApp buttons. A yellow date tile (Tuesday 22 Sep 2026, 10:30-11:00 AM, Agent-led Maya Brooks, Lobby 1200 Alder St) sits above a 'Unit to show' photo card (Unit 204 - The Alder). A yellow 'AI follow-up' card drafts 'Thanks for visiting. Would you like to continue with an application for Unit 204?' with Send Follow-up / Edit. A checklist (Confirmation sent, 24 hour reminder, Reschedule, Mark Completed) closes it. A CRM task built around one appointment.

items.title: Wellness insights - mood line over rose gradient with energy/stress tiles
items.description: A mental-wellness 'Your trends' screen on a pink gradient, greeting 'Hi Sam / Only you'. A 'Mood - Mostly okay' line chart spans Jul 18 - Sep 10 with a 9 weeks / 6 mo toggle. A two-by-two of soft cards follows: Energy 'Lower lately', Stress 'High 3 weeks', Workload 'Heavy for 4 wks', Journal '9 of 9 weeks'. A floating bottom bar (home, Insights, +) closes it. The rose palette and gentle copy make self-tracking feel like care, not audit.

items.title: Wellness insight - 'High for the last three weeks' stress explainer
items.description: A stress-insight screen on a peach-pink gradient. The headline 'High for the last three weeks' is followed by 'Your usual is Mild to Moderate. Since Aug 27 you've said High.' A line chart marks '3 weeks above usual'. 'What you tagged on those weeks' lists Deadlines 3, Customer escalations 2, Sleep 2. A closing card recalls 'What helped last time' (box breathing, blocked focus mornings) with 'Try Box breathing' / 'See pattern' buttons. The screen connects a trend to its causes and a next step.
